title: Hardware models
content:
# Hardware models

The fleet standardises on three Catalyst 9000 families. Each family has one role, so spares and configuration templates can be shared.

| Family | Role | Why this family |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Catalyst 9500 | Core and distribution | High-speed uplinks, redundant power and fans, StackWise Virtual for the core pair |
| Catalyst 9300 | Access at HQ (stacked) | StackWise-480 stacking, PoE+ for phones and access points |
| Catalyst 9200 | Access at branches | Lower cost, simple stacking for small sites |

## Common traits

- All switches run **IOS XE in install mode**; see [[IOS XE upgrade procedure]].
- Management uses VLAN 99 only; see [[VLAN plan]].
- Core, distribution and every access stack have two power supplies on separate feeds.

## Spares

| Item | Kept at | Quantity |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Catalyst 9300, 48-port PoE+ | HQ store room | 2 |
| Catalyst 9200, 24-port PoE+ | HQ store room | 1 |

See [[Switch inventory]] for where each model is installed.
